37179-limbo-and-other-essays-to-which-is.title: To Which Is Now Added Ariadne In Mantua
37179-limbo-and-other-essays-to-which-is.creator: Unknown
37179-limbo-and-other-essays-to-which-is.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. slackly kept garden which looks towards the steep hill dotted with cows and sheep. But in that corner, behind the shapeless Portugal laurels and the patches of seeding grass, there still remains, beneath big trees, what the children used to call the "Rabbits' Villa." 'Tis merely a wooden toy house, with green moss-eaten roof, standing, like the lake dwellings of prehistoric times, on wooden posts, with the tall foxgloves, crimson and white, growing all round it.

arxiv-1903-10950.title: A Probabilistic Generative Model of Linguistic Typology
arxiv-1903-10950.creator: Johannes Bjerva Yova Kementchedjhieva Ryan Cotterell Isabelle Augenstein
arxiv-1903-10950.description: Abstract In the principles-and-parameters framework, the structural features of languages depend on parameters that may be toggled on or off, with a single parameter often dictating the status of multiple features. The implied covariance between features inspires our probabilisation of this line of linguistic inquiry—we develop a generative model of language based on exponential-family matrix factorisation.

arxiv-2210-06542.title: Voting From Jail WORKING PAPER Thanks: We thank Roger Pharr and Andrea Wang for their contributions to data collection and matching. We thank Ted Enamorado and Ariel White for their helpful insights. This project was supported by Arnold Ventures and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.
arxiv-2210-06542.creator: Anna Harvey, Orion Taylor
arxiv-2210-06542.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Anna Harvey, Orion Taylor. We leverage new data on daily individual-level jail records and exploit the timing of incarceration to estimate the causal effects of jail incarceration on voting from jail in 2020. We find that registered voters booked into county jails for the full duration of 2020 voting days were on average 46% less likely to vote in 2020, relative to registered voters booked into the same jails within 7 – 42 days after Election Day.

arxiv-2402-14308.title: Ground-Fusion: A Low-cost Ground SLAM System Robust to Corner Cases
arxiv-2402-14308.creator: Jie Yin, Ang Li, Wei Xi, Wenxian Yu, Danping Zou*
arxiv-2402-14308.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jie Yin, Ang Li, Wei Xi, Wenxian Yu, Danping Zou*. We introduce Ground-Fusion, a low-cost sensor fusion simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system for ground vehicles. Our system features efficient initialization, effective sensor anomaly detection and handling, real-time dense color mapping, and robust localization in diverse environments. We tightly integrate RGB-D images, inertial measurements, wheel odometer and GNSS signals within a factor graph to achieve accurate and reliable localization both indoors and outdoors.

arxiv-2409-13904.title: High-dimensional learning of narrow neural networks
arxiv-2409-13904.creator: Hugo Cui
arxiv-2409-13904.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hugo Cui. Recent years have been marked with the fast-pace diversification and increasing ubiquity of machine learning applications. Yet, a firm theoretical understanding of the surprising efficiency of neural networks to learn from high-dimensional data still proves largely elusive. In this endeavour, analyses inspired by statistical physics have proven instrumental, enabling the tight asymptotic characterization of the learning of neural networks in high dimensions, for a broad class of solvable models.

arxiv-2410-10561.title: ( t , q ) (t,q) -Series Invariants of Seifert Manifolds
arxiv-2410-10561.creator: Louisa Liles
arxiv-2410-10561.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Louisa Liles. Gukov, Pei, Putrov, and Vafa developed a q q -series invariant of negative definite plumbed 3 3 -manifolds with spin c structures, building on earlier work of Lawrence and Zagier [ 7 ] . This was recently generalized to an an infinite family of two-variable ( t , q ) (t,q) -series invariants by Akhmechet, Johnson, and Krushkal (AJK) [ 1 ] . We calculate one such series for all Seifert manifolds with b 1 = 0 .

arxiv-2412-07310.title: Integrability of certain Hamiltonian systems in 2 ​ D 2D variable curvature spaces
arxiv-2412-07310.creator: W. Szumiński, A. A. Elmandouh
arxiv-2412-07310.description: Abstract The objective of this work is to examine the integrability of Hamiltonian systems in 2 ​ D 2D spaces with variable curvature of certain types. Based on the differential Galois theory, we announce the necessary conditions of the integrability. They are given in terms of arithmetic restrictions on values of the parameters describing the system.

arxiv-2504-15209.title: A Causal Convolutional Low-rank Representation Model for Imputation of Water Quality Data
arxiv-2504-15209.creator: Xin Liao, Bing Yang, Tan Dongli, Cai Yu*
arxiv-2504-15209.description: Abstract The monitoring of water quality is a crucial part of environmental protection, and a large number of monitors are widely deployed to monitor water quality. Due to unavoidable factors such as data acquisition breakdowns, sensors and communication failures, water quality monitoring data suffers from missing values over time, resulting in High-Dimensional and Sparse (HDS) Water Quality Data (WQD).

arxiv-2506-15827.title: H i asymmetries in spatially resolved simba galaxies 2025 H i asymmetries in spatially resolved simba galaxies – 11
arxiv-2506-15827.creator: Nadine A. N. Hank, Marc A. W. Verheijen, Sarah-L. Blyth, Romeel Davé, Kyle A. Oman, Nathan Deg, Marcin Glowacki
arxiv-2506-15827.description: Abstract We present a study of the neutral atomic hydrogen ( H i ​) content of spatially resolved, low redshift galaxies in the simba cosmological simulations. We create synthetic H i data cubes designed to match observations from the Apertif Medium-Deep H i imaging survey, and follow an observational approach to derive the H i size-mass relation.

arxiv-2509-15608.title: Enhancing WSI-Based Survival Analysis with Report-Auxiliary Self-Distillation
arxiv-2509-15608.creator: Zheng Wang, Hong Liu, Zheng Wang, Danyi Li, Min Cen, Baptiste Magnier, Li Liang, Liansheng Wang (🖂)
arxiv-2509-15608.description: Abstract Survival analysis based on Whole Slide Images (WSIs) is crucial for evaluating cancer prognosis, as they offer detailed microscopic information essential for predicting patient outcomes. However, traditional WSI-based survival analysis usually faces noisy features and limited data accessibility, hindering their ability to capture critical prognostic features effectively.

pmc-11556247.title: Psychological and physiological benefits of horticultural therapy for Chinese older adults
pmc-11556247.creator: Li Xiaoyi, Ahmad Hassan, Jiang Tao, Zhang Deshun
pmc-11556247.description: BackgroundGardening as a leisure activity has been shown to be potentially beneficial for older adults, this study aimed to assess the physiological and psychological impacts of a specific horticultural activity, watering indoor plants, compared with playing a computer game - the Klondike Solitaire Card Game.

pmc-12623649.title: Characteristics of KRAS WT pancreatic adenocarcinomas: results of a large French multicentric cohort
pmc-12623649.creator: Noémie Trystram, Jérome Cros, Hélène Blons, Simon Garinet, Rémy Nicolle, Delphine Le Corre, Shu Lin Zhao, Jim Biagi, Alexandre Harlé, Thierry Conroy, Vinciane Rebours, Julien Taïeb, Laetitia Dahan, Pierre Laurent-Puig, Jean-Baptiste Bachet
pmc-12623649.description: Background:Genome and transcriptome analysis has enhanced the characterisation of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), paving the way for targeted therapies. Tumours KRAS wild type (WT) represent a unique subgroup.Objectives:Characterise the population and molecular abnormalities present in KRAS WT PDAC.Design:Clinical and molecular data from a large retrospective cohort of KRAS WT PDAC were analysed.

pmc-12836955.title: The impact of EMS transport models on pediatric life-saving interventions and outcomes in emergency care: a prospective observational study based on the REPEM survey
pmc-12836955.creator: Caner Turan, Eylem Ulas Saz, Ali Yurtseven, Oihane Morientes Carbajo, Danilo Buonsenso, Ahmed Soliman, Sevcan Bilen, Sevcan Bilen, Gamze Gokulu, Pinar Cay, Hayri Levent Yilmaz, Mehmet Adnan Ozturk, Murat Dogan, Utku Ozer, Tugce Kalin, Gamze Gokalp, Sule Demir, Candemir Karacan, Nilden Tuygun, Ahmet
pmc-12836955.description: BackgroundPediatric patients requiring life-sustaining interventions (LSIs) constitute a critically ill population characterized by a high risk of rapid clinical deterioration, necessitating precise and timely medical interventions. Emergency Medical Services (EMS) transport strategies vary, with the Franco-German (FG) (physician-led) “stay and play” model emphasizing advanced prehospital care and the Anglo-American (AA) (paramedic-led) “scoop and run” approach prioritizing rapid transport.

pmc-13075546.title: Spatial omics for profiling the dynamic tumor microenvironment
pmc-13075546.creator: Hao Nguyen, Merrin Mary Eapen, Quan Nguyen, Ankur Sharma
pmc-13075546.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Spatial transcriptomics (ST) and spatial proteomics (SP) have revolutionised our ability to map RNA and protein distributions within intact tissues, shedding new light on the dynamic interactions that drive physiological processes in healthy and diseased tissues. We discuss how the latest ST and SP technologies, large public data resources and advanced computational pipelines can be applied to study the tumor microenvironment (TME), focussing on the interactions within the TME.

pmc-13362983.title: A Prototype-Guided 3D Deep Learning Framework for Myocardial Perfusion Scintigraphy Segmentation
pmc-13362983.creator: Madallah Alruwaili, Mahmood A. Mahmood
pmc-13362983.description: Background: Myocardial perfusion scintigraphy (MPS) is widely used for noninvasive assessment of coronary artery disease, but publicly available datasets suitable for reproducible deep learning segmentation studies remain limited. This paper proposes CardioProto-SegNet, an image-only 3D anatomy-directed segmentation framework for myocardial region delineation using the public Myocardial Perfusion Scintigraphy Image Database v1.0.0 from PhysioNet, which contains 83 patient studies.

pmc-13596050.title: Clinical phenotypes of ANCA-associated vasculitis using ensemble clustering: prognostic and therapeutic insights from two Japanese cohorts
pmc-13596050.creator: Hironori Inoue, Takashi Kida, Kazuki Fujioka, Satoshi Omura, Takuya Yanagida, Yuki Shimada, Junya Kitai, Takahiro Seno, Masataka Kohno, Daiki Nakagomi, Yoshiyuki Abe, Makoto Wada, Naoho Takizawa, Atsushi Nomura, Yuji Kukida, Naoya Kondo, Hirosuke Takagi, Koji Endo, Shintaro Hirata, Naoto Azuma, Tohr
pmc-13596050.description: ObjectivesClinical heterogeneity in ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV) is not fully captured by conventional disease subtypes or ANCA serotypes. We aimed to identify data-driven, clinically meaningful disease phenotypes based on patterns of organ involvement in microscopic polyangiitis (MPA) and granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA), and to evaluate their prognostic and therapeutic implications.
